ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT "Agreement"), made as of the [2] day of April, 2026, by and between FU FAMILY LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 225 Cherry Street, 28L, New York, New York 10002 (the “Owner"); and 101 E 9 HOLDINGS LLC, a [New York] limited liability company, having an address at c/o Moonshot Development, 234 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York 10001 (the “Developer"; collectively with the Owner, the “Parties” and each individually, a"Party"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, and State ofNew York, known as Lot 48 in Block 555 on the Tax Map of the City of New York and by the street address of 105 East 9th Street, New York, New York and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Owner Land", said buildings and any other improvements thereon, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building", and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Owner Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, and State of New York, known as Lot 10 in Block 555 on the Tax Map of the City of New York and by the street address of 57 4th Avenue, New.York, New York and more particularly described in Exhibit B.annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the "Developer Land"); WHEREAS,Developer, or its affiliates and/or successors in interest, are the developers of a new building and/or other improvements upon the Developer Land and/or other land as may be acquired by Developer from time to time (such new buildings and other improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, and collectively with any existing buildings or other improvements and/or any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being hereafter referred to as the “"Developer Building", the Developer Land and the Developer Building collectively referred to herein as the "DeveloperPremises"); WHEREAS, the Parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot” as set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective.as of December 15, 1961, as amended to date (as the same may hereafter be amended or restated from time to time, hereafter referred to as the “Zoning Resolution"), in order to create a single zoning lot comprised of the Owner Land and the Developer Land (such zoning lot, as the same may be amended in accordance with Section 8 and

Section 9 hereof, is herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot') and such other agreements as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the Parties in connection with this Agreement; WHEREAS, Developer's development of Developer Building includes an amount of Development Rights (hereafter defined) in excess of the amount of Development Rights presently permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution if the Developer Land was considered a zoning lot separate and independent from the Owner Land; WHEREAS,there exists Development Rights which are appurtenant to the.Owner Premises which are in excess of the Developmient Rights utilized by the Owner Building, and the Resolution; WHEREAS, Owner and Developer desire to make available the Excess Development Rights (hereafter defined) for utilization in connection with the development of the Developer Building; WHEREAS, the Parties wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters, and wish to provide to the maximum extent possible for each Party to exercise its rights in the future without having to seek NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereto agreeasfollows: 1. Certain Definitions. In addition to the capitalized terms that are defined throughout this Agreement and the recitals, as used herein: a.“Additional Development Rights” shall mean any additional Development Rights (other than Bonus Development Rights) that may become available to the Combined Zoning Lot by expansion of the Combined Zoning Lot in accordance with the Zoning·Resolution and this Agreement to include one or more Additional Parcels. portion of the Combined Zoning Lot for a minimum of ten (1o) linear feet or may otherwise be added to the Combined Zoning Lot pursuant to the provisions of the Zoning Resolution or other applicable law. All references to Additional Parcels shall be deemed to refer to any one Additional Parcel or any combination of such AdditionalParcels.
